description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'SaveCustomFieldController' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling the saving and editing of custom fields through a Vue.js component. It manages the request data, interacts with the CustomFieldService for retrieving custom field data, and sets up properties for the front-end component based on context.

classes.name: SaveCustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller for managing the save and edit operations of custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM module. Uses Vue.js components for the front-end interactions.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary properties based on whether a custom field ID is present in the request, including localization and context-specific data.
